title: Velor

seo.title: Velor Shopify Case Study | Leandro Alonso
seo.description: A custom, mobile-first Shopify storefront developed for Velor’s premium men’s hair-care and supplement brand.

cardSummary: A complete Shopify storefront that gives the brand a distinct shopping experience while staying editable from Shopify.

hero.summary: A complete Shopify storefront for a men's hair-care and supplement brand, shaped around product clarity, mobile shopping and practical content management.
hero.outcome: A storefront that feels specific to the brand without locking the merchant into code changes for routine updates.

snapshot.focus: Premium DTC design · Mobile ecommerce · Flexible sections

context: Velor is a premium men’s hair-care and supplement brand focused on customers experiencing hair thinning.
The project involved building a complete Shopify storefront with its own visual character.
challenge: The storefront needed to translate Velor’s premium positioning into a clear ecommerce experience across mobile and desktop.
The result also needed to remain manageable from Shopify rather than depend on code for routine updates.
approach: Instead of relying on a generic theme presentation, I built the storefront structure and major sections around the brand's visual and product needs.
Product presentation, mobile behavior, editor flexibility and frontend performance guided the implementation.
solution: Developed the full custom Shopify storefront.
Established a distinct premium visual system.
Created responsive product presentation across screen sizes.
uxCro: The experience prioritizes product presentation, legibility and a composed path to purchase.
The premium visual treatment supports the brand without competing with the shopping journey.
engineering: Reusable Shopify sections keep layouts flexible and maintainable for the merchant.
Responsive and performance-aware frontend decisions support the experience across devices.
results: A complete custom Shopify storefront aligned with Velor’s premium positioning.
A merchant-editable section architecture for ongoing content management.
A composed product experience that remains clear across mobile and desktop.
